_note: Shared by kcc-run, kcc-limit-watch, and the kcc CLI. Keep one key per line and no backslashes: the bash tools read this file with sed. Values are lower-case extended regular expressions matched against the last lines of harness output. See kernel/protocols/session-continuity.md.
limit_regex.default: usage limit|rate limit|rate-limit|ratelimit|limit reached|quota exceeded|exceeded your (current )?quota|too many requests|resource_exhausted|limit exceeded
limit_regex.claude: hit your limit|limit will reset|5-hour limit|weekly limit|rate_limit_error
